title: Japanese Yen softens on BoJ's lack of hawkish guidance, potential intervention eyed
summary: The USD/JPY pair gathers strength to around 157.60 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) extends the decline due to a lack of explicitly hawkish guidance from the Bank of Japan (BoJ) after the rate hike last week.

title: Canadian Dollar seems vulnerable as Iran diplomacy hopes weigh on oil prices
summary: The USD/CAD pair attracts buyers for the third straight day and trades around the 1.4070-1.4075 area during the Asian session on Wednesday, near its highest level since July 29, touched the previous day.
